{{Top|leg}}
An '''individual field disruptor''' was a portable energy projection system, designed to counter security measures such as [[energy fence]]s. This system emitted energy signatures capable of briefly disrupting defensive energy fields. Field disruptors were usually worn on a belt or backpack. When activated, a disruptive energy field was generated around the user, allowing the user to penetrate basic energy shields. The field disruptor also found use as a secondary weapon as the energy field would also deliver a painful discharge to anyone who touched the user.
